# Axion Deep Labs

> AI integration company and R&D laboratory. Custom AI integration solutions, quantum computing research, and intelligent automation. Building production-grade software from original research.

Axion Deep Labs is an AI integration and R&D company. We build custom AI integration solutions for enterprises, conduct quantum computing research, and deliver intelligent automation systems. Every product is informed by original research and built for production.

## AI Integration Services

We specialize in enterprise AI integration — connecting LLMs, autonomous agents, and machine learning pipelines into existing business workflows. Our AI integration services span chatbots, document processing, predictive analytics, and custom AI agents.

## Research

Project DRIFT (Degradation Regimes In Iterated Field Transformations): Investigating behavioral uncertainty in quantum system state evolution under repeated manipulation. Focused on stability degradation under variation in operator ordering and diversity.

## Technical Domains

- AI Integration & Custom AI Solutions
- Enterprise AI Integration Services

- Spatial Computing & XR

## Products

- [Site2CRM](https://site2crm.io): AI-powered lead capture with real-time CRM sync
- [Made4Founders](https://made4founders.com): Startup command center for solo founders
